title: add downgrade guard, backup/restore and safe-migrations to installer & helm charts
author: Sana Malik
release_notes: Adds installer-side downgrade guard, postgres/kv backup+restore hooks, safe migration strategy and version pinning for Helm/Terraform. Backwards-compatible runtime, no action required for existing installs but operators should run a preflight and export backups before upgrading.
description: Context: Private deployments need stronger upgrade/rollback safety guarantees after a recent production incident where in-place downgrades and out-of-order migrations caused service disruption. This PR introduces three coordinated pieces: 1) a downgrade guard in the installer/operator that prevents downgrades beyond one minor version and shows a human-friendly rollback plan; 2) runtime backup and restore hooks for Postgres and the KV store that can be invoked automatically before an upgrade and during rollback; 3) a safe migration strategy and schema rollback guards that split destructive changes into two-step non-blocking migrations where possible and add idempotent rollback scripts. Changes: - Installer operator: add UpgradePlan resource validation, downgradeGuard controller with configurable policy (max_minor_skips, allowed_versions), preflight check endpoint, and a dry-run mode. - Helm charts: pin image tags and chart dependencies for private installers, introduce hooks for pre-upgrade backups (pre-upgrade Job) and post-rollback restore hooks, values for backup retention and storageClass. - Terraform modules: pin provider versions, add pre-upgrade snapshot outputs and idempotent apply logic to avoid accidental drifts during upgrade. - Migrations: split schema changes into staged migrations, add reversible SQL for all new DDL, and a migration metadata table that records applied version+checksum. - CLI: add redwood-install upgrade --plan and --execute flags, and a redwood-install backup create/restore subcommands. Motivation: provide predictable, auditable upgrade paths for on-prem/VPC customers and reduce human error during migrations. Commits summary: 1) add-operator-downgrade-guard (controller, unit tests) 2) helm-backup-hooks (pre/post hooks + values) 3) terraform-pin-providers (module updates, docs) 4) migrations-safe-upgrade (split migrations, rollback SQL) 5) cli-backup-commands (integration tests) Changed areas/files: - operator/cmd/upgrade_controller.go: add downgrade guard checks and policy evaluation snippet: "if requestedVersion < currentVersion && skipCount > cfg.MaxMinorSkip { return error }" - charts/private-installer/templates/backup-job.yaml: new pre-upgrade Job with PVC snapshot steps - charts/private-installer/values.yaml: new keys backup.enabled, backup.storageClass, downgradeGuard.maxMinorSkip - terraform/modules/installer/main.tf: pin azurerm & aws provider versions and add snapshot outputs - migrations/2026_01_10_01_add_analytics_fk.up.sql and .down.sql: split migration with reversible DDL - cli/cmd/upgrade.go: new --plan flag and preflight invocation - tests/e2e/upgrade_smoke_test.go: add smoke test for upgrade + rollback scenario Review convo summary: Ethan: requested clearer errors and a migration dry-run output; found a potential race between backup job completion and release of old PVCs. Priya: asked for docs and a non-interactive mode for CI/CD pipelines; requested to pin chart dependencies. Luis: asked for deterministic replays of migration metadata and stronger test coverage for failed-restore cases. Author responses: pushed fixes for error messages, added a preflight wait for backups with a 5-minute timeout, added chart dependency pins, and extended e2e to cover failed-restore path. CI: initial run - unit tests pass, helm lint had one warning and terraform fmt failed on module; fixes pushed and all checks passed on re-run. Security scan flagged broad RBAC on the pre-upgrade job; narrowed to a specific serviceAccount and documented justification. Merge: Squash and merge after approvals and green CI. Docs: added a new section to private-installer/README.md describing the upgrade plan workflow and recommended operator runbook. Rollout notes: opt-in guard enabled by default for new installs; existing clusters get a helm values flag to enable guard during next upgrade. This PR intentionally avoids automatic destructive downgrades; operators must run an explicit CLI plan+execute to perform non-trivial rollbacks.
commits: 5 commits: add-operator-downgrade-guard (controller + unit tests) | helm-backup-hooks (templates + values) | terraform-pin-providers (module bumps + docs) | migrations-safe-upgrade (split migrations + reversible SQL) | cli-backup-commands (cli + e2e)
changed_files_summary: Key files: operator/cmd/upgrade_controller.go (new downgrade guard controller, ~250 LOC), charts/private-installer/templates/backup-job.yaml (pre-upgrade job), charts/private-installer/values.yaml (backup and guard flags), terraform/modules/installer/main.tf (provider pinning + snapshot outputs), migrations/2026_01_10_01_add_analytics_fk.up.sql and .down.sql (reversible DDL), cli/cmd/upgrade.go (plan/execute flags), tests/e2e/upgrade_smoke_test.go (new scenarios), README.md (runbook). Small snippets included for clarity, no large diffs inlined.
review_thread:
Ethan Cole (reviewer): 'Please provide an explicit error code and user-facing message when a downgrade is rejected; also add a dry-run output that lists checked invariants.'
Sana Malik (author): 'Added standardized error codes (ERR_DG_01) and a --plan output that prints the invariants. PTAL.'
Priya Nambiar (reviewer): 'We need a non-interactive flag for CI and pins for chart deps.'
Sana Malik: 'Added --non-interactive and pinned chart dependencies to Chart.yaml. Also documented CI runbook.'
Luis Ortega (reviewer): 'What happens if backup restore fails mid-rollback? Need explicit compensating action and alerting.'
Sana Malik: 'Added a failed-restore alert and idempotent retry logic; operator will abort and require manual confirmation if retries exhausted.'
Approvals: Ethan Cole approved after final changes; Priya approved; Luis approved with conditional comment requesting a post-mortem template be added to runbook (done).
notes_for_ops: Before upgrading production clusters: 1) run 'redwood-install backup create --name pre-upgrade-YYYYMMDD' 2) run 'redwood-install upgrade --plan' and review output, 3) run 'redwood-install upgrade --execute' in non-interactive CI use the --non-interactive flag. To rollback: use 'redwood-install backup restore --name <pre-upgrade>' then run 'redwood-install upgrade --execute --target-version <previous>' if allowed by downgrade guard or consult support for manual rollback guidance.
changelog_entry: installer: add downgrade guard, pre-upgrade backup hooks, reversible migrations, and terraform/helm version pinning; introduces redwood-install backup and upgrade plan commands
test_coverage_summary: Unit tests added for downgrade guard policy evaluation and migration metadata table; integration tests added for pre-upgrade backup job and failed-restore retry paths; e2e smoke test simulates upgrade+rollback and passed in CI after fixes.
